briefdescription.para: Returns the minimum allocation size for acachedq with the given capacity.

parameterdescription.para: maximum number of entries that can fit in the cachedq.

simplesect.para: minimum number bytes the cachedq buffer should have.

briefdescription.para: Initializes the cachedq with a maximum capacity.

detaileddescription.para:
buf
a buffer that can accommodate at least capacity elements.
capacity
maximum number of entries that can fit in the cachedq.
buf pointer casted to cachedq_t*.
Use cachedq_memsize() to determine the size of buf.
Multiple entries can be enqueued if buf points to an array. Use count to indicate how many entries should be enqueueed, starting from buf.
Multiple entries can be dequeued if buf points to an array. Use count to indicate how many entries should be dequeued.

parameterdescription.para: pointer to preallocated memory for the first entry.

briefdescription.para: Returns the current number of entries in the cachedq.

simplesect.para: number of entries in the cachedq.

detaileddescription.para: A variation of the DPDK ring buffer that uses cached variables to improve the performance. It accepts vuint64_t as data type.
